mapper.update: UPDATE branch SET b_active = 1 WHERE b_idx = #{brnIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT b_idx AS brn_idx, p_idx AS ptn_idx, b_name AS brn_name, b_description AS brn_description, b_address AS brn_address, b_phone AS brn_phone, b_sns AS brn_sns, b_hours AS brn_hours, b_active AS brn_active, b_url AS brn_url FROM branch WHERE b_idx = #{brnIdx}

SELECT b.b_idx AS brn_idx, b.b_name AS brn_name, b.b_address AS brn_address, b.b_active AS brn_active, b.b_url AS brn_url, b.b_hours AS brn_hours, b.b_phone AS brn_phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx) AS space_count FROM branch b WHERE b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} ORDER BY b.b_created DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE branch SET b_active = CASE WHEN b_active = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END WHERE b_idx = #{brnIdx} AND p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND b_active IN (1, 2)
UPDATE space s JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx SET s.s_active = 1 WHERE s.b_idx = #{brnIdx} AND b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND s.s_active != 0
UPDATE space s JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx SET s.s_active = 2 WHERE s.b_idx = #{brnIdx} AND b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND s.s_active != 0
UPDATE space s JOIN branch b ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx SET s.s_active = CASE WHEN s.s_active = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END WHERE s.s_idx = #{spcIdx} AND b.p_idx = #{partnerIdx} AND s.s_active IN (1, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT s_idx AS spc_idx, b_idx AS brn_idx, s_type AS spc_type, s_name AS spc_name, s_price AS spc_price, s_max_capacity AS spc_max_capacity, s_description AS spc_description, s_img AS spc_img, s_active AS spc_active FROM space WHERE b_idx = #{brnIdx} ORDER BY s_idx
